decision_time: Daily 00:00 UTC state known by the decision close (24h trailing return per panel asset, 365-day trailing percentile).
execution_time: Experiment-specific deterministic measurement module; no strategy selection.
failure_condition: Defer/kill if variant-concentrated, temporally unstable, cost fragile, tail concentrated, breadth/missingness driven, not distinct from existing states, or blocked by PIT/measurement-process identity.
mechanism: Fixed, already-FAILED CROSS_SECTIONAL_MOMENTUM measurement process (4 registered lookback variants, pooled family-first) conditioned on one new preregistered cross-sectional dispersion state.
objective: Measure whether the fixed CROSS_SECTIONAL_MOMENTUM family has state-conditioned daily utility relative to FLAT, conditioned on point-in-time cross-sectional return dispersion across the frozen 20-asset Breadth V2 panel.
origin: Bounded Jigsaw preregistration; distinct from the historical CROSS_SECTIONAL_MOMENTUM excess-return proposition (which failed) and from JIGSAW_TREND_CONDITION_DEPENDENCE_V0 (different state, process, and panel).
prediction: Higher point-in-time cross-sectional dispersion predicts weaker subsequent daily CROSS_SECTIONAL_MOMENTUM utility relative to FLAT; any reusable relation must survive family-variant, temporal, cost, and tail attacks.
required_data: Existing validated Binance USD-M 1h OHLCV for the frozen Breadth V2 20-asset panel only; DEV_2024 plus pre-2024 warm-up for percentile normalization.
